tasks.label: Move Workflow: Build + Copy to OBS
args: $cmake='C:\Program Files (x86)\Microsoft Visual Studio\2022\BuildTools\Common7\IDE\CommonExtensions\Microsoft\CMake\CMake\bin\cmake.exe'; $files=@('CMakeLists.txt','buildspec.json'); $files += Get-ChildItem 'cmake/common' -Recurse -File | ForEach-Object { $_.FullName.Substring((Get-Location).Path.Length+1) }; $hash=(Get-FileHash $files -Algorithm SHA256 | ForEach-Object Hash) -join ''; $stamp='build_x64\.move-workflow-cmake-identity'; $old=if(Test-Path $stamp){Get-Content $stamp -Raw}else{''}; if($hash -ne $old){ Write-Host 'Project identity changed - refreshing CMake configuration'; & $cmake -S . -B build_x64 -DENABLE_QT=ON; if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){exit $LASTEXITCODE}; Set-Content $stamp $hash } else { Write-Host 'Project identity unchanged - using existing CMake configuration' }; & $cmake --build build_x64 --config RelWithDebInfo; if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){exit $LASTEXITCODE}; & powershell.exe -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File '.vscode\copy-to-obs.ps1'; exit $LASTEXITCODE

tasks.label: Move Workflow: Clean + Rebuild
args: $cmake='C:\Program Files (x86)\Microsoft Visual Studio\2022\BuildTools\Common7\IDE\CommonExtensions\Microsoft\CMake\CMake\bin\cmake.exe'; & $cmake -S . -B build_x64 -DENABLE_QT=ON; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }; & $cmake --build build_x64 --config RelWithDebInfo; exit $LASTEXITCODE
